slot.brief: arrange four related words into a logical/chronological sequence and identify which option gives the correct order

stem:
Arrange the following words in a meaningful logical sequence:

1. Plant
2. Seed
3. Flower
4. Fruit

verdicts.working: Seed germinates into a plant; the plant produces flowers, which develop into fruit. Sequence: 2, 1, 3, 4.

working:
Natural growth cycle: seed (2) germinates into a plant (1), the plant bears a flower (3), and the flower develops into fruit (4) — hence 2, 1, 3, 4. (B) places the plant before the seed and the fruit before the flower; (C) puts the flower before the plant exists; (D) begins with the flower and ends with the plant, reversing the cycle.

Independent check: Seed germinates into a plant; the plant produces flowers, which develop into fruit. Sequence: 2, 1, 3, 4.
solution: A seed (2) germinates into a plant (1); the plant bears a flower (3), which develops into fruit (4). Hence the sequence is $2,1,3,4$.
